name: smwmusic-super-mario-bros-3-plumbing-to-the-x-treme-athletic-overworld
title: Super Mario Bros. 3 - PLUMBING TO THE X-TREME!!! ~ Athletic / Overworld 2 (Remix)
description:
Did an unnecessarily intense arrangement of Athletic / Overworld 2 from Super Mario Brothers 3. Something in my heart told me to do this, and I have no regrets.

Easily my favorite SMB3 track! I just really love upbeat songs, and the athletic themes in SMB3 and SMW were arguably what gave me the tastes I have in VGMs.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@0 replaces @9 to save on space).

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. D Major (Remix Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. C Major (Original Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. C# Major (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Voice Clip, but at the cost of SMW-Compatibility
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Voice Clip [turned on by default]
